mapper.select: select resource_id from oj_practice_operation
select resource_id from oj_practice_theory

select resource_id from oj_course where
and resource_id in
#{courseId}
('')
SELECT user_id,count(lesson_id) as course_count from oj_lesson_record group by user_id
select distinct submit_user_id from oj_lesson_paper_evaluate

select count(p.resource_id) as operationPracticeCount, count(t.resource_id) as theoryPracticeCount from oj_practice_solved s left join oj_practice_theory t on t.resource_id = s.practice_id left join oj_practice_operation p on p.resource_id = s.practice_id where s.submit_user_id = #{userId} and s.solved = 1

select s.submit_user_id as user_id, count(p.resource_id) as operationPracticeCount, count(t.resource_id) as theoryPracticeCount from oj_practice_solved s left join oj_practice_theory t on t.resource_id = s.practice_id left join oj_practice_operation p on p.resource_id = s.practice_id where s.solved is true
and s.submit_user_id in
#{userId}
group by s.submit_user_id

select resource_id from oj_course_lesson
where type = #{lessonType}

select count(distinct oj_course_lesson.resource_id) as lessonAllCount, SUM(case when oj_course_lesson.type = 0 then 1 END)as theoryLessonAllCount , SUM(case when oj_course_lesson.type = 1 then 1 END ) as expLessonAllCount from oj_course_lesson join oj_course on oj_course.resource_id = oj_course_lesson.course_id

select CASE WHEN t.content IS NOT NULL AND t.content != '' THEN t.content ELSE p.title END AS `name`, CASE WHEN t.content IS NOT NULL AND t.content != '' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS businessType, CASE WHEN t.content IS NOT NULL AND t.content != '' THEN t.resource_id ELSE p.resource_id END AS resourceId, 2 as `type`, DATE_FORMAT(s.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as `date` from oj_practice_solved s left join oj_practice_theory t on t.resource_id = s.practice_id left join oj_practice_operation p on p.resource_id = s.practice_id where submit_user_id = #{userId} and s.create_time >= #{startTime} and s.create_time <= #{endTime}

select o.`name`, o.resource_id, t.studyCount, o.description as `desc`, g.lessonCount from oj_course o LEFT JOIN (select oj_course.resource_id, count(distinct oj_lesson_record.resource_id) as studyCount from oj_course left join oj_lesson_record on oj_course.resource_id = oj_lesson_record.course_id where oj_lesson_record.user_id = #{userId} group by oj_lesson_record.course_id) t on o.resource_id = t.resource_id left join (select c.resource_id, count(l.course_id) as lessonCount from oj_course c LEFT join oj_course_lesson l on c.resource_id = l.course_id group by l.course_id) g on o.resource_id = g.resource_id

select user_id,count(distinct lesson_id) as learned_type from oj_lesson_record where course_id in (select resource_id from oj_course) and lesson_id in (select resource_id from oj_course_lesson) GROUP BY user_id
